description: This source file defines the RetryMiddleware class for AWS SDK in PHP, responsible for handling retries of failed requests with configurable retry logic, delay strategies, and error handling.

classes.name: RetryMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class that manages retry logic for AWS SDK requests, providing configurable decider and delay strategies, handling HTTP status codes and error exceptions to determine if a request should be retried.

methods.name: createDefaultDecider
methods.description: Creates a default retry decider function with support for error codes, status codes, and curl error conditions, allowing customization of retry logic.

methods.name: isRetryable
methods.description: Determines if a failed request is eligible for retry based on error type, error codes, status codes, and curl errors.

methods.name: exponentialDelay
methods.description: Calculates an exponential backoff delay with jitter for retry attempts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RetryMiddleware with provided decider, delay, handler, and optional stats collection flag.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes the middleware, handling the retry logic asynchronously with promise chaining based on the decider and delay functions.
